left.raw_text: Controls (Group D) - Significant medical condition that would make long-term follow-up difficult

right.raw_text: II. Controls (Group D) - Any medical problems associated with retinal vascular abnormalities (i.e., hypertension, systemic vasculitis, carotid insufficiency, etc.)

left.raw_text: III. Controls (Group D) - Visual acuity worse than 20/200

right.raw_text: IV. Controls (Group D) - Inability to maintain stable fixation for OCT imaging

left.raw_text: V. Controls (Group D) - History of major eye surgery (vitrectomy, cataract surgery, scleral buckle, other intraocular surgery, etc.) within 90 days of enrollment

right.raw_text: VI. Controls (Group D) - History of another eye disease or condition that may alter retinal perfusion, permeability, or retinal anatomy

left.raw_text: VII. Controls (Group D) - Substantial media opacity (cataract, corneal scar, vitreous hemorrhage) that may interfere with study imaging
